    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(8.0)
    .extrude(22.0, taper=9.293)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .polygon(6, 4.00)
    .cutBlind(-5.43)
)

nodes.name: mcts2-diversify
nodes.code:
import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(8.0)
    .extrude(22.0, taper=9.293)
)
recess = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=22.0).polygon(6, 4.00).extrude(-5.43)
result = result.cut(recess)
show_object(result)
